Sakshi Bhise’s journey through Data Analytics Courses in Pune at 3RI Technologies looks at her practical learning, project exposure, and development of analytics skills before taking up her role as a Data Executive at HireageInsight. Table of Contents Shrutika Patil September 17, 2026 3:32 pm Introduction What does it take to turn an interest in data analytics into skills that can be used in a real workplace? For Sakshi Bhise, the journey began with a decision to learn data analytics in a more practical way. She enrolled in the Data Analytics Course at 3RI Technologies with the aim of gaining a better understanding of how data is handled, analyzed, and presented. Her experience at 3RI Technologies was not limited to learning individual tools. It gave her an opportunity to bring different skills together and gain practical exposure to data-related tasks. This learning journey became an important part of her transition into the professional world and eventually led her to a Data Executive role at HireageInsight. The Challenge For Sakshi Bhise preparing to enter the analytics field, understanding individual tools is only one part of the learning process. At 3RI Technologies, we focus on helping her to understand how these tools work together when handling real data. Sakshi Bhise needed to build her fundamentals while also gaining practical familiarity with the steps involved in turning raw data into useful information. Through the Data Analytics Courses in Pune , we introduced her to key areas of analytics and gave her opportunities to practice them through hands-on learning. The training covered: Data preparation: Sakshi worked on understanding, cleaning, and organizing data before using it for analysis. Data querying: She gained practical exposure to SQL for retrieving and working with information from databases. Analysis with programming: Python exercises helped her understand how programming can be used for data analysis and handling larger datasets. Reports and dashboards: With Power BI and Tableau, she learned how data can be presented through reports and visual dashboards that are easier to understand. Business-focused learning: Case studies and practical projects helped her connect analytics concepts with situations that resemble workplace requirements. Communication of findings: The training also encouraged her to present insights in a clear and structured manner rather than simply displaying numbers or charts. Career preparation: Mock interviews, resume guidance, and career-oriented support were included to help her prepare for the transition from training to employment. At 3RI Technologies, the aim was to make Sakshi’s learning experience more connected to practical work. Instead of treating Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI, and Tableau as separate subjects, the training helped her gradually understand how these skills can come together across different stages of an analytics workflow. The Learning Approach at 3RI Technologies The Data Analytics Training in Pune program at 3RI Technologies is structured as a 5-month course with 2 real-time projects . The curriculum combines instructor-led learning with practical assignments, business use cases, portfolio development, and interview preparation.Sakshi’s learning journey can be viewed through four connected stages: Foundation: Statistics, data concepts, and analytical thinking Core tools: Advanced Excel and SQL for data preparation and analysis Analysis and visualization: Python, Power BI, Tableau, and dashboard development Application: Business case studies, projects, mock interviews, and career preparation The course also introduces Generative AI as a supporting layer for activities such as query assistance, reporting, and repetitive analytical tasks, while keeping analytical thinking at the center. The Learning Path of Data Analytics Courses in Pune The five-month Sakshi’s learning structure progresses from fundamentals to practical application rather than treating every tool as an isolated topic. Weeks 1–4 – Building the foundation: Sakshi would begin with data analytics fundamentals, statistics, probability, data types, and the role of analytics in business decision-making. Weeks 5–8 – Working with Excel: The focus moves toward spreadsheet-based analysis, formulas, functions, pivot tables, reporting, data cleaning, and business-oriented Excel exercises. Weeks 9–12 – Developing SQL skills: She works with databases and queries, including filtering, grouping, joins, subqueries, CTEs, and analytical functions using business datasets. Weeks 13–16 – Python and visualization: Python fundamentals are followed by Pandas, NumPy, and visualization concepts. Learners also work with Power BI for data transformation, DAX, dashboards, KPIs, and interactive reporting. Weeks 17–20 – Projects and career preparation: The final stage brings the skills together through real-time projects and business case studies. She work toward portfolio development while practicing technical and HR interview questions and receiving resume and career guidance. This progression gives Sakshi an opportunity to move from understanding data to working with it and finally communicating insights from it. The Outcome of Data Analytics Training in Pune At 3RI Technologies, we understand that learning data analytics is not only about completing a course or becoming familiar with different software tools. For Sakshi Bhise, the learning process was about gradually developing practical skills that could be used in a professional environment. Sakshi Bhise’s journey eventually led to a Data Executive role at HireageInsight, marking an important step from structured training to workplace application. During her training, the focus was on bringing different areas of data analytics together rather than learning each skill in isolation. Her learning journey included: Area of Learning Practical Exposure at 3RI Technologies Data handling and reporting Using Excel to organize, work with, and present data Database querying Practicing SQL to retrieve and work with relevant information Analytical skills Using Python for data-related analysis and practical exercises Data visualization Creating reports and dashboards using Power BI and Tableau Business understanding Working with business-oriented datasets and case studies Practical application Applying concepts through project-based learning Career preparation Taking part in interview preparation and receiving resume and career guidance The purpose of this approach was to help Sakshi become familiar with the different stages involved in working with data—from handling information and performing analysis to presenting findings in a clear format. Practical exercises and projects gave her opportunities to apply what she learned beyond regular classroom discussions. Her role at HireageInsight represents the next stage of her journey. While employment outcomes depend on several factors, including an individual’s skills, effort, interview performance, and opportunities, the structured training, practical exposure, and career preparation at 3RI Technologies formed part of Sakshi’s overall learning experience. Data Analytics Training at 3RI Technologies Sakshi Bhise’s journey at 3RI Technologies focused on learning through regular practice and project work. During her Data Analytics Training in Pune , she worked with tools such as Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI, and Tableau while building an understanding of practical data analysis. The real-time projects helped her apply classroom concepts to practical tasks and become more familiar with handling and presenting data. This learning experience supported her transition from training to her role as a Data Executive at HireageInsight .
